description: A seated woman in a fringed red and brown layered robe, with a beaded necklace and bracelets, writes with a stylus on a clay tablet resting on her lap. She is barefoot in an open courtyard at dusk. Behind her, a mudbrick wall carries a relief of a walking lion and a star rosette, and a brazier of glowing coals sits at the right. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible text.
